purpose: Specification for implementing stepwise migration of versioned data formats, defining the pipeline principle, function conventions, error handling, version detection, extension steps, and test requirements.
summary: Pipeline principle: each migration takes the previous step output, even when skipping versions
Migration function conventions: one input one output, idempotent, no side effects, non-destructive
Error handling: roll back to original on failure, skip future versions, treat undetected version as v1
Implementation pattern: CURRENT_VERSION constant and MIGRATIONS registry keyed by target version
Core apply_migrations logic with ascending application and rollback in Python
Migration function examples for dict data and text-based string transformation
Self-describing version detection via YAML comment, YAML field, or JSON field
Procedure for adding a new version following the Open-Closed principle
Test requirements table covering conversion, multi-step, idempotence, rollback, future version, detection failure
Implementation example: forge doc_structure migration script
tasks: Implementing a versioned data format migration
Adding a new version migration function
Implementing version detection for YAML or JSON data
Reviewing migration code for rollback and idempotence
title: バージョンマイグレーション実装仕様
